_label: DIRECT LINK CHECK — research record, not an approval
method: Each candidate url was requested once with curl (GET, follow redirects of that url only, 30 s timeout) through the environment's HTTPS proxy. Status code and effective URL were taken from curl; page_title from the served <title>; language_served from the <html lang> attribute; free_access from whether the served HTML contained the article text with no sign-in/paywall prompt; duration only where the page text itself states one. No scripts were executed and nothing else was downloaded. For each host, the licence/terms page linked from the resource page footer (or its licence notice) was opened once and short phrases were quoted.
